additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0483683
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue
. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Tank&Rast
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset:
MP / R0 170002778
Charger ID / Serial No.:
UU4Lub
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Charger is often losing OCPP Connection. I checked on AWS, and it was offline between 10.03 - 14.03, and then went daily offline for several minutes.
I connected remotely and, while the router XF4 is always up and running (not rebooting, always reachable at 10.20.17.2), the webUI is not available and says the device is unreachable:
I monitored the charger this morning, and as soon as it receives requests from the Backend, it goes offline. This is for example an issue for authentication:
I believe this router XF4 has a problem and needs to be replaced.
Please go onsite and replace XF4.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG

Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
